meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行开发计划，并行调度多个子代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你希望让代理按既定计划自动推进开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Execute your development plan automatically while coordinating parallel subagents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to follow a defined plan and handle multiple subtasks in parallel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成只做指挥、不亲手干活的角色:先读取一份工作计划,把其中的任务拆成小块,再派出多个子代理同时执行。它自己负责选计划、记进度、检查结果和收尾,直到计划里的所有待办项全部完成为止。
howto.when: 规划完成后,当你说“ulw-execute”“execute plan”“continue plan”等,或要求运行 `.omo/plans` 里的计划时触发。若没有计划而你说“start work”,它会先生成计划再执行。

say.note: 读取并执行该计划文件

say.text: execute plan,继续跑完剩下的任务
say.note: 从第一个未完成项继续推进

say.text: resume plan,接着上次没做完的继续
say.note: 恢复同一会话上次的计划进度

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator only: reads the plan, splits work into small units, and spawns parallel subagents to implement. It handles plan selection, progress, verdicts, and wrap-up until all top-level checkboxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggered after planning when the user says 'ulw-execute', 'execute plan', etc., or asks to run a plan in `.omo/plans/`. On 'start work' with no plan, it bootstraps a plan first, then executes.

say_en.note: Reads and executes that plan file.

say_en.text: execute plan, keep running the remaining tasks.
say_en.note: Continues from the first unfinished item.

say_en.text: resume plan, continue where we left off.
say_en.note: Resumes this session's unfinished plan work.
